svg.title: Albury - Club Alex - whole upper-basement floorplan
svg.desc: Twenty-one rooms and supporting spaces, including the backstage store and preparation room directly north of the permanent stage. Guest club rooms west; operations east. Bar and games northwest, cinema southwest, wine suite south centre, screened mews arrival northeast. Diagrammatic guest and service connections. Approximate floor area 11,000 to 12,000 square feet. Schematic, not to scale.
svg.text: Private club, screened mews arrival and household operations
NORTH / REAR - UNDER THE TERRACE AND GARDEN
Other room sizes and door positions
Route lines show adjacency; widths and doors are schematic.
The bar envelope and backstage allocation are approximate design references; other room sizes and all door positions remain schematic.
Backstage store/preparation room, projection booth, staff overnight room and garden store are included. No new floor area is added.
